name: Prive Card
summary: Prive is a private global wallet with a Visa Platinum card, aimed at high-value payments. You hold stablecoins such as USDC, USDT, EURC and PYUSD in self-custodial wallets, fund in GBP, USD, EUR, NGN, KES, MXN or BRL, and spend up to US$100,000 per transaction depending on your verification tier, with virtual and physical cards.

kyc.notes: Prive uses verification tiers, and your spending limits depend on your tier. It does not publish the documents each tier requires. Prive may support reusable KYC, letting you reuse identity data verified elsewhere where available.

pros: High limits: up to US$100,000 per transaction on higher verification tiers
Virtual and physical Visa Platinum cards
Self-custodial stablecoin wallets for USDC, USDT, EURC and PYUSD
Fiat funding in GBP, USD, EUR, NGN, KES, MXN and BRL
Withdrawals to local bank accounts in 80+ countries
cons: Card fees are not published on the main site
Limits depend on your verification tier
Apple Pay, Google Pay and cashback are not mentioned
FX is described as competitive, but no rate is published

faq.question: What is the Prive Card?
faq.answer: The Prive Visa Platinum is a card linked to your Prive wallet, a private global wallet for high-value payments, payment links and concierge access. It comes in virtual and physical form.

faq.question: What are the Prive Card limits?
faq.answer: Up to US$100,000 per transaction. The exact limits depend on your verification tier.

faq.question: What can I fund Prive with?
faq.answer: Stablecoins including USDC, USDT, EURC and PYUSD, held in self-custodial wallets, or fiat in GBP, USD, EUR, NGN, KES, MXN and BRL. Withdrawals reach local bank accounts in 80+ countries.

faq.question: What fees does the Prive Card charge?
faq.answer: Prive lists its card fees on a separate card fees page and describes its FX as competitive, without publishing a rate on the main site. Check the fees page before ordering.

limits.dailySpend: Depends on verification tier (up to US$100,000 per transaction)

availabilityNotes: Prive does not publish a list of supported or restricted countries. It offers fiat funding in GBP, USD, EUR, NGN, KES, MXN and BRL and withdrawals to local bank accounts in 80+ countries, and says the card is accepted at 130M+ locations worldwide. Check eligibility in the app before signing up.
howToGet: Sign up for a Prive wallet at prive.money.
Complete identity verification for the tier you need; higher tiers unlock higher limits.
Fund your wallet with stablecoins (USDC, USDT, EURC or PYUSD) or in GBP, USD, EUR, NGN, KES, MXN or BRL.
Check the card fees page, then order the Prive Visa Platinum card (virtual or physical).
Spend online or in stores at Visa merchants worldwide.
